title: The Raise Kit
h1: Say the number, then stop talking. Seven days to get ready for that moment.
sub: Negotiate a raise in your current job: a seven-day plan, a four-line ask, and what to say to each of seven common pushbacks.

items.p: Write the evidence log, find the market range, choose your number and plan B, and name your real alternative.
Put the request on one page your manager could forward unchanged. Say the ask aloud three times.
Ask for twenty minutes with a clear purpose, then send a short recap the same day.

faq.a: A PDF guide with printable worksheets, a Google Sheet and a Notion import, plus AI prompts for rehearsing.
The plan runs seven days, one step a day. The conversation itself is built to take about twenty minutes.
Anyone asking for more pay in a job they already have. It is built for asking without threatening to leave, not for negotiating a new offer.
The guide has a section on what to do after a no, a recap email that turns 'maybe next cycle' into criteria you can meet, and a menu of non-base options.

faq.q: Can I print it or use it on a tablet?
faq.a: Both. Print the worksheets, or fill them in on a tablet with any PDF app.

faq.q: Is this employment or legal advice?
faq.a: No. It is a preparation kit and general education only.
